_what: Impact numbers shown on the home and About stats bands, displayed rounded DOWN to a friendly floor with a '+'. Sources: artifacts = public model count on the Tanit XR Sketchfab profile (sketchfab.com/TanitXR reported modelCount 99 on 2026-09-16, verified against the profile's own modelsUrl) -> shows 90+. Note the history: this figure was 60, was lowered to 42 on 2026-09-12 because only 42 public artifact pairs appear in ref/archive-data.json, and was raised to 99 on 2026-09-16 on the stronger evidence of the live Sketchfab profile. The gap means the website archive publishes far fewer artifacts than Sketchfab hosts - worth closing by adding the missing models to ref/archive-data.json. sites = distinct 'place' values in archive-data.json, i.e. documented monuments/locations (Byrsa Hill, the Tophet, Baths of Antoninus, the Roman villas, Medina of Tunis, Water Temple of Zaghouan, Zawiya of Sidi Sahbi, the flood-revealed Neapolis site) - the coarser 'site' grouping used by the archive filters is 5 (Carthage, Kairouan, Medina of Tunis, Neapolis, Zaghouan); volunteers = members of the Tanit XR Slack workspace (Ines, 2026-09-12: 85+); reach = LinkedIn followers + newsletter subscribers + recent post impressions, conservative - NOT re-verified on 2026-09-12 or 2026-09-16 because the Chrome extension was unavailable both times.
